answer: Every claim climbs the garden of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vine re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the tundra of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
